name: Living in Limbo: Prologue
source:
Living in Limbo: Prologue is a short visual novel filled with creepy cute monster girls. 

You follow Nai the succubus as she demonstrates how a demons work in this strange place, guiding lost souls to a place called 'The Pillar'. 

[From [url=https://mamottshuu.itch.io/living-in-limbo-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Living in Limbo: Prologue》是一部简短的视觉小说，充满了令人毛骨悚然的可爱怪物女孩。

你跟随魅魔奈，她展示了恶魔如何在这个奇怪的地方工作，引导迷失的灵魂到一个叫做“柱子”的地方。

[来自[url=https://mamottshuu.itch.io/living-in-limbo-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
